{"CommandLine":"python -c "
import cv2, numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from ultralytics import YOLO
from modules.defect_detector import compute_gradcam

model = YOLO(r'D:\acceleration\best.pt')
for p in [r'D:\acceleration\dataset\val\rust\rust_00003.png', r'D:\acceleration\dataset\val\scratch\scratch_00023.png']:
    img = Image.open(p)
    cam, boxes = compute_gradcam(model, img, 3) # or whatever class
    print(p)
    if cam is None:
        print('CAM is None')
    else:
        print('CAM shape:', cam.shape, 'min:', cam.min(), 'max:', cam.max(), 'mean:', cam.mean())
        print('CAM percentile 85:', np.percentile(cam, 85))
        thresh_val = max(0.50, np.percentile(cam, 85))
        _, bin_mask = cv2.threshold(np.uint8(cam * 255), int(thresh_val * 255), 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY)
        contours, _ = cv2.findContours(bin_mask, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
        print('Num contours:', len(contours))
        for cnt in contours:
            area = cv2.contourArea(cnt)
            x, y, bw, bh = cv2.boundingRect(cnt)
            print(' Contour area:', area, 'min_area needed:', (cam.shape[0]*cam.shape[1])*0.005, 'bw, bh:', bw, bh, 'max allowed:', cam.shape[1]*0.9, cam.shape[0]*0.9)
